description: This is a shell script used for testing Git mirror push operations, including creating repositories, pushing branches and tags, updating, removing, and force updates, as well as configuration testing.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Inverts the exit status of a command, returning 0 if the command fails and 1 if it succeeds.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories, 'main' and 'mirror', initializes them as git repositories, and sets up remote 'up' pointing from 'main' to 'mirror'.
